name: VSDFullBody: The Virtual Skeleton Database Full Body CT Collection
creator: Michael Kistler
usage: Real volumetric anatomy source for educational CT rendering and radiographic forward projection. Postmortem data must not be represented as normal living-patient physiology.
integrityPolicy: Verify the source archive checksum before ingestion. Preserve source provenance and HU values. Derived browser volumes must remain attributable to this source.
repositoryPolicy: Source archives, extracted imaging data and generated browser volumes are not committed to Git. They are prepared/deployed separately.
pathologyPolicy: Any pathology not supported by source metadata must be explicitly labelled as Bucky Lab simulated pathology and applied as a derived 3D teaching-volume transform rather than painted onto final images.
